events.title: SvelteKit 1.0 released
events.summary: The Svelte team shipped SvelteKit 1.0 on December 14, 2022 — a full-stack framework with file-based routing, SSR, and compile-time optimizations.
events.about: SvelteKit pairs Svelte's compile-away framework with adapters for Vercel, Netlify, and Node — shipping less JavaScript to the browser than many React SPAs. It became the go-to for teams wanting React-like productivity with smaller bundles and simpler mental models.

narrative.whyChosen: SvelteKit 1.0 gave the 'disappearing framework' a production-ready app shell.
narrative.whyImportant: It validated compile-time frameworks as an alternative to virtual-DOM giants.
narrative.problemSolved: Svelte needed routing, SSR, and deployment adapters before teams could build real products on it.
